people.name: Nacon
people.line: Threshing floor where Uzzah touched the ark.

people.name: Uzzah
people.line: Died while moving the ark; place named after him

translations.web: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
translations.bsb: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark, because the oxen had stumbled.
translations.kjv: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
translations.asv: And when they came unto the threshing-floor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
